stories.title: BPI projections for the NBA season: Ranking all 30 teams and stacking Finals favorites
stories.summary: ESPN's Basketball Power Index projections for the 2026-27 NBA season are out, including a ranking of all 30 teams.

stories.title: Ravens acquire two-time Pro Bowl center Jurgens in trade with Eagles
stories.summary: The Ravens have acquired two-time Pro Bowl center Cam Jurgens in a trade with the Eagles.

stories.title: Rahm leaving LIV Golf in blow to future of bankrupt league
stories.summary: Two-time major champion Jon Rahm is leaving the LIV Golf League and is working to finalize a separation agreement by Oct. 15, his attorney said.

stories.title: Altman retires as winningest coach in Oregon hoops history
stories.summary: Dana Altman, the winningest coach in Oregon men's basketball history with 382 victories and nine NCAA tournament berths, has retired after 16 seasons.

stories.title: OBJ signs with Vikings on practice squad after release by Giants
stories.summary: The Vikings are signing wide receiver Odell Beckham Jr. to their practice squad, a source told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.
